card: Decouples all secondary indexes from internal node types like CBlockIndex and CChainState, moving chain sync logic out of BaseIndex into node::SyncChain and dispatching notifications without holding cs_main. Consolidating the synchronization and notification paths fixes an index startup race under -reindex-chainstate that caused redundant rewinds, and eliminates a window where gettxspendingprevout served stale data during reorgs. Moving index processing behind interfaces is a prerequisite for running indexes in separate processes (#10102) and sharing the chain sync mechanism with wallet rescans (#15719).
changed_since_previous: Rebased onto recent master changes, moving BlockInfo back from kernel to interfaces and MakeBlockInfo to node (reversing part of #34079), while updating txospenderindex wiring and tests.
evidence: Commit c00719c2d9: 'Avoid a race condition in index startup where indexes set m_synced = true too early... causing those blocks to trigger the Rewind() call in the BaseIndex::BlockConnected notification handler, and pointlessly remove and then re-append the same blocks. This race condition was easy to reproduce just by running the test/functional/feature_coinstatsindex.py...'

Commit ce3f249009: 'Previously, during a reorg window, gettxspendingprevout would return stale (pre-reorg) index data until the new chain tip arrived; now the index reflects disconnections immediately.'

Commit 84bb3a75ae: 'It is also a potential performance improvement since it avoids holding cs_main while processing all indexing notifications. Previously cs_main was held while sending some notifications in the attachChain sync thread.'
problem: Secondary indexes directly query internal node types and hold cs_main during notification dispatch and synchronization, causing lock contention with block validation and blocking indexes from running out-of-process. In addition, separate sync and notification execution paths caused startup races under -reindex-chainstate (triggering redundant block rewinds and reappends) and briefly served stale data for disconnected blocks during chain reorganizations.

risk.why: Altering index notification synchronization and removing cs_main locks could introduce thread-safety issues, deadlocks, or index state corruption during chain reorgs or node shutdown.

scope_notes: A substantial portion of the diff consists of moving sync and notification registration code from src/index/base.cpp to src/node/chain.cpp and src/node/interfaces.cpp, alongside mechanical conversions of CBlockIndex pointers to interfaces::BlockRef and interfaces::BlockInfo.
summary: Decouples secondary indexes (txindex, blockfilterindex, coinstatsindex, and txospenderindex) from node internals by eliminating direct references to CBlockIndex, CChain, and CChainState. Extracts background index synchronization into a new node::SyncChain function and avoids holding cs_main during index notifications and sync. Consolidates block append and rewind logic into unified notification callbacks and avoids starting sync threads when indexes are already caught up.
